title: The projection formula with a finitely presented constant coefficient
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and assume $R^qf_*F=0$ for every sheaf of $A$-modules $F$ and every $q>N$, for one integer $N\geq0$. Work in the unbounded derived categories of sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaves on the small étale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $K\in D^-(X_{\Et},A)$, where $D^-$ means that the cohomology sheaves vanish in all sufficiently large degrees. Let $M$ be a finitely presented $A$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], with $M_X,M_Y$ the associated constant sheaves [def-kun-constant-sheaf]. Then the canonical projection map
$$
Rf_*K\otimes^L_AM_Y\longrightarrow Rf_*\bigl(K\otimes^L_AM_X\bigr)
$$
is an isomorphism. Here derived tensor is the ordinary uncompleted étale derived tensor of [def-kun-derived-tensor], and $Rf_*$ and the canonical projection morphism are the unbounded K-injective direct image and its adjunction mate of [def-kun-projection-formula-map]. The map is natural in $M$.

proof.text: Apply the canonical projection transformation to bounded finite free constant complexes. Constant finite powers are dualizable, as are bounded complexes of dualizable sheaves. The proved source-library projection formula at a dualizable coefficient therefore gives invertibility, via the bounded finite free constant projection theorem.
A finitely presented module over the Noetherian coefficient ring has bounded finite free approximation triangles with arbitrarily low error cones.

Exact constant and inverse image functors preserve upper bounds. The uniform direct-image cohomological bound gives an upper amplitude N; tensoring adds upper bounds. Both coefficient functors therefore have common upper amplitude b+N.

Use the approximation-comparison theorem to obtain the projection isomorphism at M[0], then transport along the exact-constant-functor single-degree comparison. The remaining factors in finiteConstantProjectionMap are canonical isomorphisms.

lean.statement: theorem isIso_finiteConstantProjectionMap (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (N : ℕ) (hcd : ∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (q : ℕ), N < q → IsZero ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).obj ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))) (K : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (hK : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, b < q → IsZero ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K)) (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) [Module.FinitePresentation A M] : IsIso ((finiteConstantProjectionMap A f K).app M)
lean.note: The helper is the canonical projection natural transformation restricted to constant modules and transported by the canonical single-degree inverse-image and constant-sheaf isomorphisms. Its NatTrans type includes naturality in M. No replacement of the canonical map, ring, site or unbounded derived category.
